items.title: Samsung to Double HBM4 Output Next Year
items.summary: Samsung is set to significantly increase its production of HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM, which are critical for high-performance computing and AI applications. This move is expected to enhance the supply chain for advanced memory solutions, benefiting developers working on resource-intensive projects.

items.title: ChatGPT Now Knows What You Do on Other Websites via Ad Collector
items.summary: A new feature in ChatGPT allows it to track user behavior across different websites through an ad collector, raising significant privacy concerns. Developers and engineers should be aware of the implications this has for user data and ethical AI usage.

items.title: Pirate Face Rescues LLM Models from Deletion
items.summary: Pirate Face has launched a project aimed at preserving large language models (LLMs) that are at risk of deletion, providing a valuable resource for developers and researchers. This initiative highlights the importance of open-source contributions in safeguarding AI advancements.

items.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Released with Enhanced Features
items.summary: The release of Qwen Image 2.1 introduces improved image generation capabilities, making it a powerful tool for developers in creative and technical fields. This update is significant for those leveraging AI in their design and development workflows.

items.title: Custom Home Server Built from Spare Parts
items.summary: A new blog post details the process of building a custom home server using spare parts, providing insights into DIY server setups. This is particularly relevant for developers looking to optimize their local development environments or host applications independently.
